page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.s3 server family. It is configured with 4 dedicated vCPUs and 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. The instance runs on the KVM hypervisor. It does not include any bundled local storage or integrated GPUs, and it is provisioned with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The underlying processor configuration lacks support for advanced instruction sets, with flags for Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), and cryptographic acceleration (AES, SHA_NI) marked as unavailable. This hardware profile suggests a focus on standard integer operations rather than specialized vector processing, matrix multiplication, or hardware-accelerated encryption.

With a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is structured for compute-focused workloads that do not require large memory footprints or local storage. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation provides predictable processing power for entry-level compute tasks, lightweight web serving, and basic utility processing, while avoiding the overhead of unused memory or storage resources.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.large is an x86_64 compute-oriented server instance within the ecs.s3 family, utilizing the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs and 8.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a 2.0 GB per core ratio. The instance does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, and it lacks advanced CPU instruction sets such as AVX, AVX512, AMX, and hardware-accelerated cryptography. This resource profile is designed for workloads requiring dedicated CPU allocation with a low memory footprint. It is suitable for basic web serving, lightweight computational tasks, and general-purpose utility workloads that do not rely on specialized vector or matrix acceleration. The lack of bundled storage requires external network-attached storage for persistent data.
